# DSH Studio v0.7.3

这是针对 v0.7.2 插件树启动失败的基础修复版本。它修复 `dsh-code@0.9.1` 与
`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8` 重复注册 Loader 入口后无法启动的问题，并把 Studio 集成改为
与对标桌面项目一致的运行时层，不再永久污染用户 Profile。

## 新增

- 启动前新增完整插件树预检，直接使用 Harness 自己的 `--dump-config` 组合结果检测重复
  Loader 入口，并列出每个冲突 ID 的来源层。
- 新增真实本地启动验收：从包含旧 Studio bundle 和冲突 `dsh-code` 的 Profile 出发，必须
  完成安全修复、公告随机回环端口、通过 HTTP 健康探测且不触发默认浏览器交接，才允许发布。

## 变更与安全

- Studio integration 改为启动器拥有的运行时 `--patch`，通过
  `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules` 公共回退目录解析，不再作为 bundle 写入用户 Profile。
- 旧 Profile 会自动移除遗留的 Studio bundle，同时保持全部第三方插件及其顺序；只有包含
  Web App 的 Profile 才会注入集成层，headless Profile 不受影响。
- 自动恢复只允许停用“同时是已安装依赖且处于启用状态”的第三方 bundle。内置层、Studio
  层、用户补丁或无法确认来源的冲突都会安全拒绝启动，不会被自动修改。
- 桌面桥接公共合同保持 Protocol 3，本次只修正 Profile 组合与启动基础链路。

## 修复与打磨

- 修复 `duplicate loader entry id: code-runtime` 导致 Harness 退出，随后 Studio 只显示
  `harness closed its output without announcing a port` 的问题。
- rc.8 与 `dsh-code@0.9.1` 实际重复的三个入口为 `agent-presets`、`code-runtime` 和
  `session-reference`。Studio 现在会在插件启动前停用这个冲突 bundle、保存可逆开关、重新
  组合并继续启动。
- 修复运行时补丁能被读取，但 `@moresyl/dsh-studio-integration` 无法从 Profile 解析的问题；
  私有集成模块现在会安全物化到公共模块回退目录。
- 修复「修复」再次检查已经合格的目录选择器时，资格补丁不幂等的问题。
- 修复启动 Studio 时 Harness 仍按 Web CLI 默认行为弹出系统浏览器页面的问题；启动和自动
  重启现在都强制使用 `--no-open`，页面只在 Studio 自己的窗口中呈现。

## 安装与更新

建议所有 v0.7.2 用户升级。若 Profile 中启用了与 rc.8 冲突的旧版 `dsh-code`，首次启动
v0.7.3 会将它保留在已安装列表但切换为停用；待插件发布兼容版本后，可在插件面板重新启用。
现有 `~/.dsh` Profile、插件依赖和会话数据不会被删除。

请用 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 核对下载；应用内更新仍强制验证 Tauri 签名。Windows Authenticode
与 Apple Developer ID 凭据仍未配置，因此操作系统可能显示未知发布者或要求首次放行，
这与更新签名及 SHA-256 校验属于不同层次。

[英文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.7.3/CHANGELOG.md) · [中文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.7.3/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md) · [比较 v0.7.2...v0.7.3](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/compare/v0.7.2...v0.7.3)

<!-- dsh-notes:en -->
# DSH Studio v0.7.3

This foundation patch fixes v0.7.2 startup failures caused by Loader entry
conflicts between `dsh-code@0.9.1` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8`.

## Added

- Startup preflights the exact Harness `--dump-config` composition and reports
  duplicate Loader ids with their owning layers before plugins boot.
- Release acceptance now boots a real conflicting local profile through safe
  repair, loopback port announcement and an HTTP health probe, while asserting
  that the default-browser handoff never runs.

## Changed and secured

- Studio integration is a launcher-owned runtime `--patch` resolved through
  the shared `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules` fallback. It is no longer
  persisted in user bundle lists; legacy entries migrate in place and headless
  profiles remain untouched.
- Automatic recovery can disable only an active third-party bundle that the
  profile also declares as an installed dependency. Core, Studio, user-patch
  and unknown-owner conflicts fail closed.
- The desktop bridge public contract remains Protocol 3; this release changes
  only profile composition and startup foundations.

## Fixed and polished

- Fixed `duplicate loader entry id: code-runtime` followed by
  `harness closed its output without announcing a port`. With rc.8,
  `dsh-code@0.9.1` also duplicates `agent-presets` and `session-reference`;
  Studio now switches off only that bundle, records the reversible state,
  recomposes and starts.
- Fixed runtime patch loading when the private Studio integration package was
  not resolvable from the profile.
- Runtime qualification is idempotent when Repair examines an already
  qualified directory picker.
- Fixed Studio startup opening an external browser through the Web CLI default.
  Initial launch and supervised restarts now always pass `--no-open`, leaving
  presentation inside the Studio window.

## Install and update

All v0.7.2 users should upgrade. A conflicting older `dsh-code` remains
installed but is switched off on first v0.7.3 start; re-enable it after a
compatible plugin release. Existing profiles, dependencies and sessions remain
intact.

Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; in-app updates still require the Tauri
signature. Windows Authenticode and Apple Developer ID credentials remain
unconfigured, so OS trust warnings are separate from updater and SHA-256 checks.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.7.3/CHANGELOG.md) · [中文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.7.3/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md) · [Compare v0.7.2...v0.7.3](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/compare/v0.7.2...v0.7.3)
